title: Eudaly and Light v. Southwest Florida Presbytery
disposition_detail: Administratively out of order; no merits reached. The SJC held that PCA jurisdiction over the complainants ended February 9, 2020, when they affiliated with another branch of the visible church (BCO 38-3), so they lacked standing to file the complaint. Vote: 22-0-0; Lucas and White absent.
first_summary: The SJC dismissed a complaint against Southwest Florida Presbytery because the complainants had left the PCA and lacked standing.
summary: The SJC held an October 2021 complaint against Southwest Florida Presbytery administratively out of order because the complainants had affiliated with another branch of the visible church on February 9, 2020, ending PCA jurisdiction over them under BCO 38-3. They therefore lacked standing. The ruling reached no merits and supplies no description of the underlying presbytery action; the vote was 22-0-0, with Lucas and White absent.
